build_ModelDBIR: build a depth-based image rendering model that unprojects RGBD maps to a colored point cloud and renders into target views
run_ModelDBIR_forward: run the ModelDBIR forward pass with RGB images, depth maps, foreground masks, and cameras to render target views
create_rgbd_point_cloud: create a colored point cloud from source view RGB images and depth maps using get_rgbd_point_cloud
render_point_cloud_pytorch3d: render a point cloud into target camera views using render_point_cloud_pytorch3d with configurable point radius and topk
subsample_point_cloud: subsample a point cloud to a maximum number of points using random permutation without replacement
